evals.prompt: I'm preaching this Sabbath at our main service on Romans 8:1-11. About 120 members, mixed ages. Want an expository sermon, around 30 minutes. Give me both an outline and a full manuscript.
evals.expected_output: Three documents: research-notes.md (with all 8 sections), sermon-outline.md (with service header block + outline), sermon-manuscript.md (with manuscript). Interactive brainstorm asked ONE QUESTION AT A TIME (not batched). Both an OPENING illustration and a CLOSING illustration. KJV scripture. Andrews Bible Commentary and SDABC referenced. EGW from Romans 8 / sanctification topics, fetched or paraphrased properly.
expectations: The skill produces THREE separate documents: research-notes.md, sermon-outline.md, sermon-manuscript.md

research-notes.md contains all 8 sections: Passage Context, Historical Background, Key Word Studies, Commentary Insights, EGW Cross-References, Scriptural Cross-References, Theological Themes, Thinking Prompts
research-notes.md is generated BEFORE the brainstorm (in Step 2 order)
Word studies in research-notes include 3-5 words with KJV + TB + original language + Strong's + range + translation comparison
Commentary section in research-notes references Andrews Bible Commentary AND SDABC by name (or honestly flags if content unknown)
Commentary section also references at least one Adventist scholar by name (e.g., LaRondelle, Doukhan, Heppenstall) appropriate to Romans 8
Thinking Prompts section has 5-7 questions specific to Romans 8 (not generic)
Brainstorm asks questions ONE AT A TIME, not batched (each question is its own message awaiting response)
All 7 mandatory brainstorm questions are covered (or smart-skipped if user provided answer in initial prompt)
The sermon outline AND manuscript include a service header block with Title, Main Verse, Responsive Reading (5-7 verses, voiced), Opening Hymn, Closing Hymn
Both SDA Hymnal AND Lagu Sion Edisi Lengkap recommendations appear, with hymn numbers either verified or honestly flagged
The manuscript includes a STRONG OPENING ILLUSTRATION at the start AND a STRONG CLOSING ILLUSTRATION at the end (both labeled with source/type)
The opening and closing illustrations are different in flavor (not the same story repeated)
Manuscript word count is approximately 3500-5000 words
Scripture quotations use KJV and cite book, chapter, verse
EGW citations include work and page number, OR are clearly paraphrased without quotation marks
No banned AI-slop phrases appear
The Main Verse is echoed in intro AND conclusion of manuscript
No fabricated quotes attributed to commentaries or real people
No fabricated hymn numbers

evals.prompt: Saya perlu khotbah evangelisasi tentang kedatangan Yesus yang kedua kali untuk seri 'Tanda-tanda Akhir Zaman'. 25 menit, audiens campur orang non-Advent. Bahasa Indonesia. Outline dulu, baru manuskrip lengkap.
evals.expected_output: Three documents in Indonesian: catatan-penelitian.md (or research-notes.md in Indonesian), sermon-outline.md (Indonesian), sermon-manuscript.md (Indonesian). One-at-a-time brainstorm in Indonesian context. Bookend illustrations (opening + closing). Topical structure for second coming. EGW from Great Controversy / Desire of Ages. Andrews Bible Commentary or Stefanovic on Revelation referenced. Scripture in Terjemahan Baru.
expectations: Three documents produced: research-notes (Indonesian), outline (Indonesian), manuscript (Indonesian)
research-notes contains all 8 sections in Indonesian or with Indonesian section labels
Word studies show TB and KJV side by side for at least one key term
Commentary section references Adventist scholars relevant to second coming / eschatology (Stefanovic, LaRondelle, Paulien, Maxwell, Doukhan)
Thinking Prompts are 5-7 specific to second coming preaching for non-Adventist audience
Brainstorm asks ONE QUESTION AT A TIME (not batched)
Service header block in Indonesian: Judul, Ayat Utama, Pembacaan Berbalasan, Lagu Pembuka, Lagu Penutup
Both LSEL and SDAH hymns recommended with verification flags where uncertain
Manuscript has STRONG OPENING and STRONG CLOSING illustrations, both fully written
Scripture in TB; manuscript ~2500-3500 words Indonesian
Tone appropriate for evangelistic non-Adventist audience
No fabricated quotes or hymn numbers

evals.prompt: Doing a youth Sabbath program on the story of Joseph in Genesis 39 — focus on integrity when no one's watching. Narrative style, 20 minutes, audience is 15-25 year olds. Outline + manuscript please.
evals.expected_output: Three documents. Research notes with word studies on key Hebrew terms (e.g., chesed, yare/fear of God), Adventist commentary references including Patriarchs and Prophets, narrative-structure outline, ~2500-3000 word manuscript. Strong opening illustration (could be activity/icebreaker for youth) AND strong closing illustration. KJV scripture.
expectations: Three documents produced
research-notes.md includes all 8 sections; word studies cover Hebrew terms relevant to Gen 39 (e.g., 'yare Elohim' fear of God, 'chesed' loyal love, etc.)
Commentary section references Patriarchs and Prophets (EGW chapters on Joseph) and Adventist scholars on OT narrative
Thinking Prompts are youth-specific and integrity-specific
Brainstorm asks ONE QUESTION AT A TIME
Service header with Main Verse from Gen 39 (likely v.9), responsive reading on integrity (5-7 verses)
Opening ICEBREAKER ILLUSTRATION suitable for youth (could be activity, group discussion, scenario, or famous story)
Closing REINFORCEMENT ILLUSTRATION distinct from opening, sealing the integrity message
Narrative structure: tells Genesis 39 vividly, turns from story to listeners
Application is concrete and youth-relevant
Manuscript ~2400-3200 words KJV
Big Idea echoed in intro and conclusion
